description.text:
Verdant (苍) is one of the three booster packs of Sun & Moon: Storming Emergence (横空出世), the first release of the Simplified Chinese Pokémon Trading Card Game, on sale in mainland China from 28 October 2022 alongside Radiant (赫), Abundant (泽) and a GX starter deck. Like the rest of the launch, its cards were chosen from the existing cards of the Sun & Moon series. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Verdant holds the Grass, Lightning and Darkness Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Its GX cards include Rayquaza GX, Decidueye GX, Electrode GX and Zoroark GX. Its main cards are numbered out of 151; shiny Pokémon, full-art and shiny full-art cards and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 204.
